recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If a concrete HL7 IG quality check is missing or regresses, track it in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher or the FHIR Confluence publication requirements rather than changing the core ImplementationGuide definition.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue asking for an IG Publisher mode that enforces HL7 IG requirements, including warnings that publisher and publisher.contact are present.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir source commit mentioning FHIR-19632 was found. The related FHIR-19012 policy decision defined the HL7 publisher/contact expectations and explicitly noted that FHIR-19632 was added so IG Publisher could enforce them.
additional_context: Current FHIR Confluence publication requirements require publisher/contact for all FHIR IGs and the HL7 work group publisher/contact form for HL7-published IGs. The FHIR IG Quality Criteria page describes QA.html warnings/errors and IG Publisher validation. The active core ImplementationGuide resource keeps publisher/contact optional base metadata, which is appropriate for all implementers rather than only HL7 publication workflows.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source change was made because changing base ImplementationGuide cardinalities or adding HL7-specific rules to the core StructureDefinition would overstate a publication/tooling policy; any remaining enforcement belongs in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher or publication guidance.
